svg.title: How SGLang sizes the KV pool
svg.desc: Before model load the scheduler records the free memory. After the weights load it keeps a slack of (1 minus mem_fraction_static) times that free memory for activations and CUDA graphs, and gives the rest to the KV pool. Dividing the rest by the bytes of one token gives max_total_num_tokens.
svg.text: KV pool size comes from a ratio, not from a profiling run
one GPU · bar lengths show the shape, not real proportions
slack_gb = pre_model_load_memory × (1 − mem_fraction_static) · kept for activations and CUDA graphs
cell_size = layers × KV heads × head size × 2 (K, V) × dtype bytes
mem_fraction_static comes from the GPU memory table in server init 2
vLLM instead measures the activation peak with a dummy forward
